title: A token probability has a surprise
hook: Two stated cases: explore the likelihood attached to one generated token.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the likelihood attached to one generated token affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Nats, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the likelihood attached to one generated token in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
